examples.title: Render a Docker Compose file that adds an LMA to a running project
examples.description: The file is passed with -f after the running project's own file. The LMA depends on the project's gma service, which only a merged file may do.

body.composeYaml:
services:
  "lma-hospital-d":
    image: "dagents/healthcare-demo-backend:local"
    command: ["uvicorn", "dagents.lma.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8085"]
    env_file:
      - "../../env/.env.shared"
      - "lma-hospital-d.env"
    environment:
      "LMA_SITE_ID": "hospital-d"
      "LMA_SITE_SOURCE": "healthcare_site_store"
      "LMA_API_PORT": "8085"
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8085:8085"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8085/api/v1/health')"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    depends_on:
      "gma":
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - "default"
    restart: unless-stopped
networks:
  "default": {}
